title: What HORBM is
summary: HORBM, the Heuristic Open Retrieval Brain Model, is Galion's retrieval brain. It answers from cards and memory, not a language model, and says it does not know on a miss.
body: HORBM is Galion's retrieval brain. A turn is a lookup, not a language model. Its parts: an ear, card retrieval, person memory, a learn pack, dialogue policy, a persona, an inner life, and a full-duplex voice loop.
